blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Armed Forces Tribunal was established under the statutory authority of the Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007.
It serves as a specialized body to adjudicate complaints and disputes of armed forces personnel.
Its primary legal jurisdiction revolves around service matters within the armed forces.
The Armed Forces Tribunal was constituted under the Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007.
The AFT specifically deals with service matters, disputes, and complaints of armed forces personnel.
